page.layout: one blank page; a small pasted handwritten slip in the lower centre; the binding edge at the right
page.notes: No printed text. A small handwritten slip is pasted in the lower centre, in German Kurrent script, with an address and a closing flourish: "Dem Ehrenvesten, frommen und vesten Herren H. Johann Steiger(?), Oberschreiber zu Bern, Herren zu Toole(?), ... ein günstiger Ehrender Herren Dienst(?)" (the lines are only partly legible, so this is not a transcription). Handwriting is not transcribed. The strip at the right edge is the binding and neighbouring page, and faint show-through may appear elsewhere on the page.
